summary: Retested the 4 fixes from iteration_52 (diff eed403a..16c40e7). (1) No paid upsell on L1 lessons: PASS. For an anonymous visitor on L1.1, Deep and Flash show only the 'Read Level 1 free' form and upsell-boundary count is 0. L2 lessons still show the UpsellBoundary in Deep and Flash (count 1). (2) Curriculum list error state: PASS. The list request was forced to return 500; the page shows the 'Couldn't load the lessons just now. Try again' error box, with no loading text and no level sections. Clicking Retry recovers: lessons and the unlock form appear. (3) unlockLevel1 rate limit: partial. 5 calls per IP per hour works: the 4th call in my run returned 429 'Too many sign-ups from here. Try again later.' (the earlier suite had already used 2 calls). But anyone can BYPASS it by sending a fake X-Forwarded-For header: 3 calls with spoofed values all returned 200. Telegram now pings only for new emails; I checked this in the code (existing-lead lookup before addLead) but could not observe it from outside. (4) Reading time and form width: PASS. Cards say 'N min skim', the hero badge says 'Skim in minutes, go deeper any time', and the lesson header says '3 min skim · ~13 min full lesson', so the numbers now match. On desktop the compact unlock form lines up with the TL;DR (both x=536, w=848). The iteration_52 regression suite still passes 12/12.

minor.issue: The rate-limit IP comes from the raw first X-Forwarded-For entry, which the client controls: curriculum.ts:205. Sending any fake X-Forwarded-For header gets around the 5/hr limit (shown: [200,200,200] after a 429). server/gate.ts already exports clientIpOf(req), which is spoof-safe because it uses req.ip with trust proxy. Fix: import clientIpOf and use `const ip = clientIpOf(ctx.req)`.
The 429 response includes data.stack with server file paths (/app/server/routers/curriculum.ts:206). Check that stack traces are stripped when NODE_ENV=production on Railway.

issues: The hero still shows '30 lessons' when the list fails (`lessons?.length ?? 30`). Minor, and the number is correct anyway.
The compact unlock form is still below the fold at y=1081, after the hero and TL;DR. This was only a suggestion in iteration_52 and was not changed.

action_items: In curriculum.unlockLevel1, replace the raw x-forwarded-for parsing with clientIpOf(ctx.req) from ../gate.js, so the rate limit cannot be bypassed with a spoofed header.
critical_code_review_comments: The 'Telegram only for new leads' check is a select followed by addLead, so two concurrent first sign-ups can both ping. This is harmless.
The rate limit counts every call, including repeats with the same email. A shared office IP gets 5 sign-ups per hour, which is fine for this audience.

success_rate.backend: 3 of 4 fixes fully verified; the rate limit works but can be bypassed (iteration_52 suite 12/12, new spoof test 0/1)
